contentText:
M.G. Siegler / Spyglass :

Review of Meta's Muse: a pretty killer AI assistant and usage rates on the free plan seem generous, but trusting Meta with personal data will take some time   —  They shipped a pretty killer AI assistant, can they keep people using it?  —  It happened.  Meta finally has a product that I really like using again.
